findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "util" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: json_schema_validate, cron_explain, text_diff, unit_convert, random_gen · Private data: qr_code, jwt_decode, random_gen, text_stats · Public sink: json_schema_validate, text_stats · Destructive: cron_explain, text_diff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: json_schema_validate, cron_explain, text_diff, unit_convert, random_gen · Private data: qr_code, jwt_decode, random_gen, text_stats · Public sink: json_schema_validate, text_stats · Destructive: cron_explain, text_diff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
